items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: By the time I first heard Miles I knew he was legendary. I heard Miles at Café Bohemia.

ctx.x: Can you recall, at the time, however old you were, were you aware that you were listening to legendary people?

Excellent question, excellent question. No I don’t think so, looking back. By the time I first heard Miles I knew he was legendary. I heard Miles at Café Bohemia. But by and large — and the other thing was you could go out and hear the legends but you could also go hear someone you never heard of play just as good and by whatever chance of fate or their own personality they never made it quote, the way the others did. I’ve talked to musicians who have stories who have traveled all over the country — they’ll go to…
At what point did you start going to live things and looking at them as a cameraman, or as a future documentary filmmaker.
